t: That this Act may be cited as the “District of Columbia Unemployment Compensation Act Amendments of 1971”.

fable.w: This section is only a short-title provision naming the Act. It establishes no process involving any party outside the federal government in a federal decision; the tempting reading that an unemployment compensation act implies claimant or state involvement fails because nothing in this text provides for any consultation, hearing, rulemaking, or right to sue.

qwen_block.w: This section is a standard short title provision. It merely establishes the name by which the Act is known. It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or interaction with parties outside the federal government, nor does it create any advisory bodies or public comment periods.
qwen_block.s: That this Act may be cited as the “District of Columbia Unemployment Compensation Act Amendments of 1971”.
